cd /app/tmp/work && python3 - <<'EOF' > /app/tmp/work/eh.json
import json,sys,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
from stress import mk_trace
rng=random.Random(3); K=8
fields=[{"name":"n%d"%i,"type":"SIZE","min":0,"max":1000} for i in range(4)]+[{"name":"c%d"%i,"type":"COUNT","min":0,"max":100} for i in range(2)]+[{"name":"f%d"%i,"type":"FLAG"} for i in range(2)]+[{"name":"id0","type":"ID","values":["a","b","c"]}]
def dt(depth,ty):
    if depth>=4: return {"field":rng.choice([f["name"] for f in fields if f["type"]==ty]),"at":"$" if rng.random()<0.5 else rng.randrange(K)}
    k=rng.choice(["add","scale","agg","t"])
    if k=="add": return {"add":[dt(depth+1,ty),dt(depth+1,ty)]}
    if k=="scale": return {"scale":rng.randint(-8,8),"term":dt(depth+1,ty)}
    if k=="agg":
        f=rng.choice([f["name"] for f in fields if f["type"]==ty]); a=rng.randrange(K); z=rng.randint(a,K-1)
        return {"aggregate":rng.choice(["sum","mean","min","max"]),"field":f,"from":a,"to":z}
    return dt(4,ty)
atoms=[{"quantifier":rng.choice(["any","all"]),"from":0,"to":K-1,"predicate":{"cmp":rng.choice(["le","ge","lt","gt","eq","ne"]),"left":dt(1,rng.choice(["SIZE","COUNT"])),"right":dt(1,rng.choice(["SIZE","COUNT"]))}} for i in range(20)]
def rr(): 
    out=[]
    for f in fields:
        if f["type"]=="FLAG": out.append(rng.random()<0.6)
        elif f["type"]=="ID": out.append(rng.choice(f["values"]))
        else: out.append(rng.randint(f["min"],f["max"]))
    return out
train=[mk_trace("tr%d"%i,"s%d"%(i%16),[rr() for _ in range(258)]) for i in range(16)]
probes=[mk_trace("pr0","s0",[rr() for _ in range(128)])]
queries=[mk_trace("q0","s0",[rr() for _ in range(1031)])]
print(json.dumps({"version":1,"window":K,"schema":fields,"atoms":atoms,"policy":{"max_width":3,"min_support":2,"min_witness":2},"train":train,"probes":probes,"queries":queries}))
EOF
/bin/time -v /app/submission/run.sh < /app/tmp/work/eh.json 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -E "Maximum resident|Elapsed|User time|System time"
